about: Refining (docs/sandbox/CONSTRUCTS.md, 'Refining'): what each production machine makes. A machine part names its 'machine' in storage.refine. The recipe is picked by the material in the machine's input, so a machine has one recipe per input material. Each batch takes 'unitsIn' of 'input' and 'seconds' of work (at least 0.1, in steps of 0.1) and gives 'unitsOut' of 'output'. Materials are the names in Recycling.json. Units are 1 to 100.
